title: PARTS_DEPARTMENT is a UI-only gate - not exercisable as a server-side fePermission cascade (out of scope)
steps:
1. GET /api/fe-permissions and confirm the permission catalog. There is NO PARTS_DEPARTMENT (or any parts-department) code - the catalog has 42 fePermission codes and none represents a Parts Department area gate.
2. POST /api/roles with fe_permissions=['partSalesView'] and cross_toggles.seeFinancialData=true (PARTS_DEPARTMENT cannot be sent - it is not a settable fePermission).
3. GET /api/roles/{id} and inspect the persisted fe_permissions AND cross_toggles.
expected:
1. PARTS_DEPARTMENT is confirmed to be a UI-only toggle with NO fePermission bundle (absent from GET /api/fe-permissions), per the ticket own out-of-scope note.
2. The API returns 201 Created and persists the bundle VERBATIM (partSalesView + cross_toggles.seeFinancialData=true).
3. No PARTS_DEPARTMENT gate materializes on fetch-back because none exists in the catalog to cascade.
CONCLUSION: This scenario CANNOT be exercised as a server-side fePermission cascade - there is nothing to cascade to. It is OUT OF SCOPE as a backend cascade check (PARTS_DEPARTMENT gating is enforced only in the UI). Verified live on staging 2026-07-09.
